# CR8 — Adaptive Learning Pipeline

> A 3-agent AI system (Ingest → Research → Generate) that transforms university curriculum
> PDFs into market-enriched learning guides, gap analysis presentations, video scripts,
> and AI avatar videos.

## Stack
Python 3.11+, FastAPI, LangGraph, OpenAI (gpt-5.1/mini/nano), ChromaDB, Tavily, Kokoro TTS, React 19 + Vite 7 + Tailwind v4 + Tanstack Query, pytest (983 backend) + Vitest (109) + Playwright E2E (17)

### Quiz API
- POST /api/quiz/start — trigger quiz generation for a completed job
- GET /api/quiz/{quiz_id}/question/{n} — fetch the nth question (0-based)
- POST /api/quiz/{quiz_id}/answer — submit an answer; returns correct/explanation
- GET /api/quiz/{quiz_id}/results — final score and per-question breakdown
- GET /api/quiz/attempts — list all attempts for the authenticated user
